authentication.notes: Standard Odoo session — no custom auth module required

response_fields.uid: integer — user ID, null if auth failed

auth.login.side_effects: Sets session cookie — store in SecureStorage

errors.session_expired: HTTP 200 with error code 100 — trigger re-auth

tags.resolve.description: Find or prepare project tags by name
tags.resolve.notes: Compare returned names against mobile tags — create missing ones via tags.create

notes.pull.description: Pull the tasks linked on this server (any project) modified since last sync; no linked task, no request

domain: {note_links.res_id of this server's live task links}
kwargs.offset: {page * 100} — pages until fewer than 100 rows, at most 50 pages

notes.pull.notes: Filtered by linked ids, not project_id: a task created in a project, or moved to one on the server, keeps syncing. geo_task_point requires erplibre_mobile_todo installed.

notes.poll.description: Lightweight poll — fetch only IDs and write_date of the linked tasks to detect changes; no linked task, no request

domain: {note_links.res_id of this server's live task links}

notes.create.description: Push a new note to Odoo — returns the Odoo ID to store locally

args.name: {note.title}
args.project_id: {outbox.params.projectId} — the project chosen for this server, or false (personal task)
args.geo_task_point: {geojson_multipoint} — only when the note has positions and fields_get finds the field

notes.create.response: integer — Odoo task ID → stored in mobile SQLite note_links (note, server config id, project.task, id, client_uuid)
notes.create.notes: tag_ids uses Odoo ORM command 6 (replace all). geo_task_point is GeoJSON string. Runs as the note's task.create row of sync_outbox; on a retry (attempts > 1) notes.find_created runs first. With a project, projects.check runs just before. AccessError, ValidationError, UserError or MissingError on create blocks the row as refused (no retry, createSentAt cleared since the server answered) until the user chooses again. A task deleted on the server is recreated only through the picker: choosing its project queues this create. project_id is sent by create only: notes.update never sends it.

projects.list.description: Projects offered for a new task on one server, cached in remote_records_cache (replaced on each read) for offline choices
projects.list.response: active projects the user can read; 500 rows means the list may be cut

leads.create.description: Push a note as a CRM opportunity (lead.create row of sync_outbox, same marker, retry search and quiet window as notes.create)

args.name: {note.title}
tag_ids: {crm.tag ids, found or created by name}
args.date_deadline: {first date entry, local day YYYY-MM-DD} — omitted when the note has no date

leads.create.response: integer — crm.lead id → note_links (note, server config id, crm.lead, id, client_uuid)
leads.create.notes: Team and salesperson are the server's defaults. done and pinned are not sent. Before create, a chosen partner is checked with res.partner search_read [('id','=',partnerId)] (active only): none or AccessError blocks the row as partner_missing. Refused create: as notes.create.

leads.update.description: Push changes to a linked opportunity

args.date_deadline: … only when the note has a date

leads.update.notes: type, partner_id, expected_revenue and active are never written: they belong to the server once created (writing active would revive an opportunity marked lost). MissingError marks the link deleted; the server leaves the note's queue only when no other kind of the note is live there. Leads are not pulled back yet; a pulled task change queues the note's opportunity on the same server.

partners.search.description: Client search for a new opportunity
partners.search.response: [[id, display_name], …] — kept in remote_records_cache (200 most recent per server) for offline search

projects.check.description: Before creating a task in a project: the project still exists, is active (as projects.list offers it) and the user sees it
projects.check.response: 1 row → create; 0 rows (gone, archived, hidden) or AccessError → the outbox row turns blocked as project_missing, no create sent, sync_target_prefs stops offering that project, and the next tap asks for a project again

notes.find_created.description: Before retrying a create whose answer may have been lost: find the task an earlier attempt created, by its marker. Runs no earlier than 3 minutes after the last create was sent (stored in params.createSentAt before sending): longer than the 30 s read timeout plus Odoo's default limit_time_real (120 s), so an uncommitted create cannot be missed
notes.find_created.response: 0 rows → create; 1 row → adopt it (notes.update with the current content, then link); several rows (a copy made on the server carries the marker too, archived or not) → the outbox row turns blocked as ambiguous with the ids as candidates, and the app asks the user which task to link

capabilities.probe.description: What a server allows on a model, cached in server_capabilities; never reads ir.model (not readable by an ordinary internal user on 17 and 18)
calls: {model}.fields_get([], attributes=[type, string, required, readonly, relation, selection]) — an unknown model answers KeyError: exists=false; AccessError: exists, no right; any other error leaves the cache unchanged
Odoo 18: {model}.has_access([], 'read'|'create'|'write'); refused, or Odoo 16-17: {model}.check_access_rights('read'|'create'|'write', raise_exception=False); neither answering → null (not blocking)
activity_ids / message_ids among the fields → activities / chatter available

notes.update.description: Push changes to an existing note

args.name: {note.title}
args.description: {note.html_description} (+ the marker when the link has a client_uuid)
args.project_id: never sent: a task moved to another project on the server stays there
args.geo_task_point: {geojson_multipoint} — only when the note has positions and fields_get finds the field

attachments.list.description: List attachments for a set of tasks

attachments.upload.description: Upload a media file (audio, photo, video) as task attachment
attachments.upload.notes: Upload only on WiFi option recommended for video files. Requires valid session cookie.

transport_policy.http: An http:// url is refused before any request (InsecureHttpError) unless the user turned on « Autoriser http (non chiffré) » in Options › Synchronisation Odoo (localStorage options.sync.allowHttp). The same rule refuses opening an application or a note's record in the web view, whose login script types the password. https is always allowed.

re_auth_strategy.trigger: JSON-RPC error code 100 (session expired) or HTTP 401 — never the error message text
steps: 3. Store new session cookie in SecureStorage key 'odoo_sync_session_{base64(app_url|username|database)}'
5. If still failing — mark this server 'error' in sync_per_server_status (the note's sync_status is derived), notify user

sync_status_values.notes: Per server in sync_per_server_status (synced | pending | error); the note's sync_status is derived from the entries of live applications: error, then pending, then synced; none left → synced if a live link remains, else local.
sync_status_values.local: Note bound to no live server
sync_status_values.pending: Some server still has to receive the note (queued offline, edited, or edited during its push); syncAll pushes it
sync_status_values.synced: Every live server received the latest pushed content
sync_status_values.error: Last push to some server failed; syncAll retries it
sync_status_values.remote_deleted: Not a status: a write() answering odoo.exceptions.MissingError marks the note_links row remote_state='deleted'; the server leaves the note's queue only when no other kind of the note is live there (a background push next to a live kind skips the deleted one). The record is recreated only when the user chooses it again in the picker; unchecking it there marks the link 'dismissed': kept as history, never pushed nor asked again

columns.odoo_id: INTEGER — legacy single binding, no longer written; migration 2026102201 copies it to note_links
columns.sync_status: TEXT DEFAULT 'local' — see sync_status_values; derived from sync_per_server_status
columns.last_synced_at: TEXT — ISO 8601 datetime of last successful sync

note_links.notes: One row per remote record of a note; an id is only valid for its config id, which includes the database. Sync config ids, per-server status keys and remembered selections all use url|username|database (migration 2026102201 upgrades the older url|username ids).

sync_pull_cursors.notes: Highest task write_date already pulled; next pull starts there (>=). Pages by write_date >= last read, excluding the ids already read at it (search_read truncates write_date to the second). Without a cursor: one day before the oldest link's last sync (device clock vs server clock).

sync_outbox.notes: One row per operation of a note on one server. attempts and running are stored before the server is contacted; success deletes the row; failure retries after 30 s doubled per attempt (1 h max); a handler may postpone a row to params.notBefore without counting an attempt, honoured even by a forced sync; blocked and incomplete wait for the user; running rows of a killed app turn failed at startup.

server_capabilities.notes: Result of capabilities.probe per server and model, used offline; probed again after one day when online.

remote_records_cache.notes: Records of a server kept for offline choices. projects.list replaces the project rows of that server as a whole; partners.search adds or refreshes the partners found and keeps the 200 most recently fetched per server.

sync_target_prefs.notes: Last choice per server and kind of target (task.create: projectId, projectName), offered first; also the project of a creation queued without a choice. Kind targets: the target kinds last checked in the picker for that server (task, lead), checked by default for a note with nothing there. A lead's client and revenue are not remembered.
